business_problem: Companies needed customer support that could answer quickly, personalize responses across siloed systems, and lower ticket-handling costs without sacrificing accuracy or escalating every issue to human agents.
solution_summary: MavenAGI built a customer-service platform around GPT-4 to automate support across self-service search, chatbot conversations, and agent-assist workflows. The system first ingests large volumes of structured and unstructured support content, including knowledge bases and interaction logs from Salesforce, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Slack, SMS, and related systems. It then connects GPT-4 to CRM records and enterprise APIs so responses can be personalized to the user and actions can be taken on their behalf. A self-evaluation layer checks whether the system is confident in its answer or action before responding, and the platform can route out-of-scope cases to human representatives. Smart Search serves instant answers in help centers, while the chatbot handles direct support and the agent-assist path recommends responses and relevant prior interactions for escalated tickets.

data_flow: Knowledge-base content, interaction logs, and CRM context are ingested into the MavenAGI platform, which uses GPT-4 to answer questions, take actions, or draft follow-ups. When confidence is low or a task is out of scope, the workflow routes the case to human agents with suggested responses and retrieved background context.
business_outcome: MavenAGI helped customers automate most support questions, cut resolution time and ticket costs, and give human representatives more time for higher-value interactions while still escalating edge cases safely.
